paper_title: Galactic axions search with a superconducting resonant cavity
notes: QUAX-a-gamma superconducting cavity (SCC) haloscope. Headline limit g_agamma < 1.03e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% single-sided CL (1.64 sigma), quoted in text and abstract (also shown as red band in Fig. 6). Applies to a narrow 45 kHz band at cavity frequency nu_c = 9.067 GHz, i.e. mass ~37.5 ueV over a ~0.2 neV wide range. Reported as a flat two-point line; endpoints from m = h*nu over 9.067 GHz +/- 22.5 kHz (m ~ 3.7498e-5 eV). Paper defines g_agamma = (g_gamma alpha / pi Lambda^2) m_a, matching the canonical L = -(g_agamma/4) a F Ftilde convention, so no conversion needed. Local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (not rescaled). A projected sensitivity (g_agamma < 4e-14 for future dilution-fridge+JPA setup) is discussed in conclusions but is not the measured limit.
